items.source: Access visibility types as determined by the modifiers on a Member or ResolvableType.
items.translation: 访问由 `modifiers` 确定的可见性类型，这些修饰符应用于 `Member` 或 `ResolvableType`。

items.source: Return the lowest AccessControl.Visibility of this instance.
items.translation: 返回此实例的最低AccessControl.Visibility。

items.source: Uses of AccessControl.Visibility in org.springframework.aot.generate
items.translation: `org.springframework.aot.generate` 包中 `AccessControl.Visibility` 的用法

items.source:
Support classes for components that contribute generated code equivalent to a
runtime behavior.
items.translation: 为贡献与运行时行为等效的生成代码的组件提供支持类。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name.
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。

items.source:
Returns an array containing the constants of this enum class, in
the order they are declared.
items.translation: 返回一个包含此枚举类常量的数组，按声明顺序排列。
